output.brief:
The Kestria buffering is almost certainly not the new CDN. Since 9 October, smart-TV app 5.2 has stalled about 5.9% of viewing time. That is the same day as the cutover and the 5.2 release. Every other client on Tessaline stalls only 0.6–0.7%, the same as before. The pattern holds across all three ISPs, so ISP congestion is out. The handball launch does not fit either: stalls started before it, and match nights are no worse. I'm fairly confident (about 85–90%) of this, based on one ad hoc telemetry query.

Recommendation: do not send the SLA notice, withhold fees or move traffic back to Corvane. It would not fix the problem and would damage the vendor relationship. Do not mute the alert; it is the one signal of an ongoing fault. Revert the TV app's adaptive-streaming settings in Kestria to the 5.1 behaviour and hold the wider 5.2 rollout until fixed. Other markets running 5.2 may be at risk, so check them. Hold off on the free-month offer. The 1 October price rise also plausibly contributed to the cancellations, and that has not been separated out. Add app-version and device breakdowns to the dashboard when the pipeline allows.
